verdict.rationale: SendGrid's own Inbound Parse webhook parses incoming email contents and attachments and posts them to a URL of your choice, which directly covers the core of the story. The pack gives only a single doc sentence, though: it never mentions pointing MX records at SendGrid or delivering parsed headers, so coverage is partial. A community note mentions an inbound SPF/DKIM check hiccup but does not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: documented MX record setup, explicit header fields in the parsed payload, API retrieval alternative, independent hands-on corroboration of inbound parsing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive email — point MX records at the service and get parsed messages (headers, body, attachments) delivered to my webhook or API

citations.quote: The Inbound Parse webhook parses the contents and attachments for incoming email to a email server, then send that data to a URL of your choice.
